html: What's on your plate affects blood pressure, cholesterol and weight, three big drivers of heart health. You don't need a strict diet: small, steady swaps add up.

image.alt: Illustration of a plate with vegetables, grains and protein
image.caption: Aim for a plate that's about half vegetables and fruit.
image.title: Illustration of a plate with vegetables, grains and protein

html:
• Vegetables and fruit, fresh or frozen
  • Whole grains like oats, brown rice and whole-wheat bread
  • Beans, nuts, fish and skinless poultry
  • Olive or canola oil instead of butter

• Salty snacks, deli meats and many restaurant meals
  • Sugary drinks and sweets
  • Fried foods and fatty cuts of meat

title: Heart-healthy eating
abstract: Simple food swaps that support blood pressure, cholesterol and a healthy weight.
